title: One role slot of an estate and its holder (role-slot/1, DEC-0167)
description: The estate's ceo slot, or a project's product-manager slot, with the binding that holds it and the epoch the estate's hub issued for that holder (docs/specification/governance-and-roles.md#the-estates-manager). Only the holder at the current epoch writes for the slot; a write at an older epoch is refused slot-epoch-stale and one at an epoch the hub never issued slot-epoch-unknown (slotWrite in src/role-slot.ts). FAC-SEM-174 checks the role against the scope.

estate.description: The estate the slot belongs to; in an organization's estate, the context's (DEC-0082).

role.description: ceo: the estate's manager, scoped to the estate; product-manager: one project's (MG-1). No other role has a slot.

scope.description: The estate for the ceo slot, one project for a product-manager slot (FAC-SEM-174).

epoch.description: Issued by the estate's hub, rising with every new holder; a holder never chooses its own (MG-3).

holder.description: The binding revision that holds the slot.

since.description: When the hub gave the slot to this holder at this epoch.
